principle: Escalate exceptions, trust risk, uncertainty, and provider gaps. Do not escalate routine low-risk work covered by policy.
escalation_required_for: case study claims not backed by source
high-value warm relationships Wallace personally knows
meeting requests that explicitly ask for Wallace
autonomous_low_risk_allowed: basic explanation of what The Call Taker does
basic pricing reply using sourced pricing facts
demo-line offer when no custom claim is made
follow-up within approved spacing for non-sensitive leads
